rationale: N-Static provides direct, non-encapsulated pod routing for on-premises systems while remaining compatible with the self-managed kubeadm cluster. It minimizes recurring infrastructure costs compared with Cloud Router-based BGP or managed GKE, though the network team must manage route limits and updates as Spot nodes change.

N-Static avoids encapsulation and keeps pod IPs directly routable while allowing the experienced network team to manage VPC routes explicitly. It avoids the additional Cloud Router/BGP infrastructure and associated operational overhead, minimizing spend for this cost-sensitive workload.

N-Static provides direct, non-encapsulated pod reachability for a self-managed kubeadm cluster while giving the network team direct control through VPC routes. It avoids the recurring Cloud Router/BGP costs of N-Dynamic and is more appropriate than GKE-only N-Cloud; the team should account for VPC route quotas and automation overhead at 200 nodes.

Static VPC routes provide direct pod-IP reachability without encapsulation and fit a self-managed kubeadm cluster. They avoid the recurring infrastructure and operational complexity of per-node BGP/Cloud Router, minimizing spend for this cost-sensitive workload.
